subject: Invoice delivery path and nightly batch cutoff — VerdantHealth onboarding
messages:
From: Sophie Carter <sophie.carter@verdanthealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: AP Team <ap@verdanthealth.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice delivery path and batch cutoff

Hi Rachel,

We’re finalizing VerdantHealth’s onboarding and need to confirm how Redwood will send invoices for our account. Two questions: 1) Do you push invoices to your customer portal/webhook or do you send pdf/xml copies via email? 2) If you do nightly pushes, what is the cutoff (UTC) so we can align our AP ingest?

Also, we need a sample invoice payload (XML or UBL) and clarity on VAT evidence fields — our local tax team will want the tax ID and reverse-charge flags in the payload.

Can you advise and share a short onboarding checklist for portal opt-in? If portal is required, we’ll need temporary email copies while our integration is built.

Thanks,
Sophie Carter
AP Manager, VerdantHealth
Attachments: none
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Carter <sophie.carter@verdanthealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery path and batch cutoff

Hi Sophie — great question and welcome aboard. Short answers up front: we support both.

Option A (recommended): portal / webhook push (API). We can deliver an XML/UBL payload to your ingestion endpoint once per day. Typical cutoff is 21:00 UTC (21:00) for the same-day emission window; anything after that goes in next day’s batch. We can discuss moving to multiple daily pushes if you need lower latency.

Option B: email copies (PDF and XML attachments) to ap@verdanthealth.com as a fallback or temporary bridge. We commonly run email copies for 30–60 days while customers finish portal onboarding.

VAT/tax evidence: the XML includes customer_tax_id, tax_rate, tax_basis, and a reverse_charge boolean. I’ve attached a small sample_invoice.xml and a portal_onboarding_checklist.pdf that lists required fields (tax id, remit address, PO mapping).

Action items for VerdantHealth to confirm so we can finalize:
- Confirm portal webhook URL or confirm that you want email copies to ap@verdanthealth.com during onboarding
- Confirm PO number field mapping (e.g., invoice->header->po_number) and whether you require PO on file to accept invoices
- Provide remit info and VAT/Tax ID for cross-border tagging

If you’d like, we can run the first week as email copies + nightly push (both) so your AP team can validate the payload before switching off the email copies.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Billing Ops, Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0147
Attachments: portal_onboarding_checklist.pdf, sample_invoice.xml
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Carter <sophie.carter@verdanthealth.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery path and batch cutoff

Adding a couple of operational notes from the ops side:
- Cutoff is configurable per-customer. Standard is 21:00 UTC but we can shift to 23:00 UTC for your ingest team if needed. Give us a target and we’ll set it for the account.
- If VerdantHealth requires SEPA/IBAN fields or reverse-charge declarations for EU entities, include the VAT ID and country code in the onboarding form so we can tag line-level taxes.
- For temporary email copies, we will add a header X-Redwood-Temp-Copy: true to make it easy for your parser to drop duplicates once you switch fully to webhook.

Kimberly Park
Billing Integrations Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachments: none
From: Sophie Carter <sophie.carter@verdanthealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: AP Team <ap@verdanthealth.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery path and batch cutoff

Thanks Rachel and Kimberly — we’ll opt into the portal push (webhook) and would appreciate a 30-day overlap with email copies while our integration runs.

We’ll provide:
- PO mapping: we will use header.po_number and will supply PO on every order (example: 789234)
- VAT/Tax ID: VH-GB-44566732 (we’re in the US/UK operations mix; tag reverse_charge=false for US invoices, true for applicable UK/EU cases)
- Webhook URL: https://ap.verdanthealth.com/ingest/redwood (staging URL first)

Can you confirm you’ll set a 21:00 UTC cutoff for nightly emission and that the temporary emails will carry X-Redwood-Temp-Copy: true? We’ll review the sample_invoice.xml and the onboarding checklist and send any follow-up questions by EOD.

Cheers,
Sophie
AP Manager, VerdantHealth
Attachments: none
